It comes from the Middian system. Pasaana, Forbidden Valley.|Tishra Kandia reports the origins of Rey's necklace to Kylo Ren|audio=Kandia-Analyzed-TROS.flac|{{Film|IX}}}} '''Tishra Kandia''' was a [[human]] [[intelligence officer]] of the [[First Order]]. She served aboard the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']], dealing with evidence and accounts of [[Resistance]] activity. In [[35 ABY]], Kandia analyzed a [[Husk necklace|necklace]] taken from the [[Jedi]]-in-[[Jedi training|training]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] for [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], which she identified as originating from the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Prepare my ship. Alert the local troops. Send in a division.''"
"''Yes, Supreme Leader.|Ren gives orders to Pryde after hearing from Kandia|audio=Ren-Prepared-TROS.flac|}} [[File:Kandia_Ren_Pryde.png|thumb|left|250px|Kandia analyzed Rey's necklace for Kylo Ren.]] Tishra Kandia was a [[human]] who served the [[First Order]] as one of its top [[intelligence officer]]s. During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[Resistance]], she was stationed on board the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']], where she was tasked with processing captured evidence and firsthand accounts of Resistance activity. In [[35 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]]. [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] considered Kandia a trusted informant''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' and gave her a [[Husk necklace|necklace]] to process that he had snatched from the neck of the [[Jedi]]-in-[[Jedi training|training]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] via their [[Force-bond]]. Kandia was able to pin down the origin of the necklace as being the [[Forbidden Valley]] on the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]] in the [[Middian system]]. She brought the necklace back to the Supreme Leader and reported this information to Ren and [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] in one of the ''Steadfast''{{'s}} corridors. Ren then ordered Pryde to prepare his [[Kylo Ren's TIE whisper|starship]] and alert any First Order [[First Order military|forces]] in that area to begin searching for Rey. The ''Steadfast'' was later destroyed during the [[Battle of Exegol]]. ==Personality and traits== [[File:OfficerKandiaFull-VillainsFirstOrder.png|right|thumb|Officer Tishra Kandia was a capable intelligence officer.]] Tishra Kandia had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. She took Kylo Ren's order to find any clues to Rey's whereabouts seriously, and left no stone unturned, making her one of the only intelligence officers who did not balk at Ren's orders to expend resources on finding the Jedi-in-training. She prided herself on the evidence that she had been able to uncover for use against the Resistance. ==Equipment== Kandia wore a gray [[First Order military uniforms|officer's uniform]] including a [[Hat|cap]]. She carried two [[code cylinder]]s which were coded to allow her access to the analysis lab on board the ''Steadfast''. ==Behind the scenes== Tishra Kandia was portrayed by [[Amanda Hale]] in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. Her surname was revealed in the film's credits while her first name was first used in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. The [[2020]] [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel|junior novelization]] of the film by [[Michael Kogge]] lists Kandia as one of the officers present during the scene in which Ren presents the head of the Resistance sympathiser [[Boolio]] to the [[First Order Supreme Council]];''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' however, as Kandia is visibly not present in that scene during the film, this article assumes the junior novelization to be incorrect. ==Appearances== *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Screen Comix)|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Screen Comix]] *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[William Shakespeare's The Merry Rise of Skywalker: Star Wars Part the Ninth]]'' ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Tishra Kandia}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Tishra}} *{{Topps|set=2019 Topps Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Series 1|cardname=Officer Kandia|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/211130/cid/13996019/2019-Topps-Star-Wars-The-Rise-of-Skywalker-38-Officer-Kandia}} *{{Topps|set=2020 Topps Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Series 2|subset=Villains of the First Order|cardname=#8 -
